tools.name: search_tariffs
tools.description: Access: API key, OAuth, or x402 payment when offered. Search current US HTS classifications by product description, code, or prefix. Optionally include origin-specific rate stacks.

tools.name: lookup_tariff
tools.description: Access: API key, OAuth, or x402 payment when offered. Look up a US HTS classification with bounded CBP CROSS ruling evidence and, when origin is supplied, its supported duty layers, warnings, coverage, and provenance.

tools.name: calculate_duty
tools.description: Access: API key, OAuth, or x402 payment when offered. Calculate supported US duty layers and fees for one import line. The response separates total import charges (duty + fees) from total landed cost (entered value + duty + fees) without estimating fact-dependent treatment.

tools.name: replay_tariff
tools.description: Access: API key, OAuth, or x402 payment when offered. Compare a supported historical tariff stack with the current stack while reporting archive coverage explicitly.

tools.name: compare_tariff_codes
tools.description: Access: API key required. Find edition-aware concordance candidates between China, US, EU, GB, and Brazil tariff systems. Supports historical as-of resolution, up to five targets, projections, and cursor pagination. Candidates are non-binding classification leads.

tools.name: list_tariff_changes
tools.description: Access: Pro API key or higher required. List customer-scoped tariff changes with optional workflow and classification filters.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.ustariffrates.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screen_import_requirements · Private data: search_tariffs, lookup_tariff, calculate_duty, replay_tariff, compare_tariff_codes, list_tariff_changes, adcvd_cash_deposit, search_rulings, get_ruling, screen_import_requirements, assess_import_entry, audit_entry · Public sink: screen_import_requirements, assess_import_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screen_import_requirements · Private data: search_tariffs, lookup_tariff, calculate_duty, replay_tariff, compare_tariff_codes, list_tariff_changes, adcvd_cash_deposit, search_rulings, get_ruling, screen_import_requirements, assess_import_entry, audit_entry · Public sink: screen_import_requirements, assess_import_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
